description: Example robot (not a default): a LEGO EV3 arm that stands still. A medium motor on A (the gripper), a large motor on B (the lift) and a touch sensor on port 1. It has no `pair` and no `profile.drivetrain`: every motor is a device of its own for command_device, and drive, turn and arc answer `unsupported`. Whatever else is plugged into the brick is a device too, without a role. `hardware` are the facts about the brick that are not motion limits (`tone_volume_pct` is read on stock firmware, `speech_volume_pct` on ev3dev), `profile` a contract RobotProfile (CONTRACT.md §3). The twin arm-sim is built from this same file.

notes: The gripper motor on A opens with positive degrees.
The lift motor on B raises the arm with positive degrees; the touch sensor on port 1 is pressed when the arm is fully down.
